scheme_name: Nirmaan Sthal Par Karya Ke Dauran A-panjeekrat Shramik Ke Mratyu Ki Dasha Me Antyeshti  Evan Anugrah Rashi Bhugatan Yojana
other_conditions: Application must be submitted within 6 months of the worker's death
Application must be submitted in the prescribed format to the designated officer
benefits_summary: Provides funeral assistance of ₹3,000, accidental death compensation of ₹4,00,000, and permanent disability compensation of ₹2,00,000 to legal heirs of unregistered construction workers who die on site.
